title: TwitchCon San Diego Firebot User Meetup
message: Hey, Firebot fans! TwitchCon San Diego is just a couple weeks away and we're considering hosting a TwitchCon Firebot User Meetup. If you're attending TwitchCon San Diego AND you'd be interested in attending a Firebot user meetup, either respond to our Discord poll or reply to zunderscore on Bluesky. Hope to see you there!

title: Feature YOUR stream on the Firebot website!
message: Hey there, Firebot users! Did you know YOUR stream could be featured on the Firebot website? Just go to Settings, then General, and enable the Feature My Stream setting. That's it! After that, whenever you're live on Twitch while running Firebot, your stream will automatically appear on our website.
